name: CENNETIC M5A Mold Vertical Machining Center
summary: The M5A is a mold-oriented vertical machining center balancing high-speed contouring with the rigidity needed for die and mold work.
body:
The M5A is a mold-oriented vertical machining center balancing high-speed contouring with the rigidity needed for die and mold work.

Equipment

Standard equipment

  • Bed — Cast Iron — Resin-sand casting (HT300)
  • Bed — Lubrication Circuit — Automatic (Auto lubrication)
  • Bed — Ball Screw — HIWIN (Taiwan)Ball Screw (Ball screw4010)
  • Bed — Linear Guideway — INA (Germany)Linear guideway (XYZ: RG45(roller))
  • Appearance — Sheet-metal Enclosure — Full enclosure (White + black)
  • Lubrication — Electric oiler — RGB electric oiler (Electric oiler)
  • Lighting — Linear work lamp
  • Spindle oil cooling — Spindle oil cooling — Chuanguan
  • Accessories — Tool holders / collets — BT40-ER32 (10 pcs each)
  • Accessories — Tool kit (1 set)
  • Accessories — Tool-holder stand (1 pcs)
  • Accessories — Manual (1 set)
  • Service — Freight — in/out province (in/out province)
  • Service — Training — on-site (On-site)
  • Service — Warranty — 1 year (1 yr)

Optional equipment

  • Bed — Spindle — Suge (Taiwan)/丹铨 (OD150mm/BT40)
  • Electrical — Feed-motor type — FANUC/Mitsubishi (XYZ: 3.0 kW/20 N·m)
  • Electrical — Spindle — FANUC/Mitsubishi (11-15 kW/52.5-98.5 N·m)
  • System — CNC: FANUC / Mitsubishi (0i-MF5 Plus/M80)
  • Tool Change — Pneumatic tool changer — OKADA (Taiwan) (Disc-typeBT40-24 tools)

About this model

This Vertical Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
